content: Tsia kaɩn amʋ́ abʋba ɩwɩasɩ ha ɔmá akpapʋ́, abʋgyi ahandɛ mblasʋ, abʋbu amʋ́. Bʋkɩ́ɩ ánɩ́ bɔ́bwɛ tɔ́á igyi yilé brégyíbrɛ́.
Bʋmáblɩ́ ɔhaa ɩwɩ asʋn laláhɛ, bʋmágyi nwɛ́ɛn ɛ́. Mboún bʋbwɛ́ɛ ahá ánɩ́ bolwií, abʋba ɩwɩasɩ ha ɔhagyíɔha.

Tsúfɛ́ brɛ́ ámʋ a, aha mimláhɛ anɩ ɛ́ anɩgyí. Asʋtɔ lɔ́wa anɩ ɔnlɩn. Anɩlɔ́fwɩ, mlí nkpábi há ɔwɔ́lɩ laláhɛ pʋ́ atɔ́á ɩtɔwá ɔha ansigyí. Anɩléyintá brɛ́ súsu lalahɛ mʋ́a tɔ́á ɩdɛ anɩ ansɩ́ pɛ ɩwɩ. Ahá bolu anɩ, anɩ ɛ́ anɩlólu amʋ́.
Támɛ anɩ nkpa Ɔhɔ́pʋ Bulu lɛ́lɛ mʋ awɩtɔlɛ pʋ́ ɔdwɛá ɔbʋ ha anɩ ɔwan.
Ɔlɛlɛ anɩ, támɛ megyí yilé kʋkʋ anɩlɔ́bwɛ sʋ, mboún mʋ nwewúun sʋ. Ɔlɔtsʋn Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋsʋ fwɩ́ anɩ lakpan lɛ́ anɩsʋ, ɔlɛlakwɩ́ɩ́ anɩ, há anɩ nkpa pɔpwɛ.
Ɔlɔtsʋn anɩ Ɔhɔ́pʋ Yesu Kristosʋ, tsɛ́ɩ́ Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ wʋ́lɩ́ anɩsʋ.
Ɔlɔbwɛ anɩ alɩ, mɛ́nɩ ɔbɔ́wa awɩtɔlɛ há anɩ, tsú mʋ́ ánɩ́ anɩ asʋ́n da ɔkpa, fówun anɩ ɩbɩ bɛ́da nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá ámʋ́ʋ́ anɩdɛ́ mʋ́ ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ amʋ.
Asʋ́n ánfɩ bʋ mʋ́tɔ́. Yɩrɩ ɩwɩ afʋsuna mʋ́ wankláán, mɛ́nɩ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ amʋ́ ansɩ́ dɩn Bulusʋ ámʋ bétsiá bwɛ́ yilé brégyíbrɛ́. Mʋ́gyí tɔ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́, ɩbɔ́wa labi há ɔhagyíɔha nɩ.
Mápʋ ɩwɩ wá mimlá nwɛ́ɛngyí, anáin ɩlɩ́ntɔ kláa, pʋ́ mbla ámʋ ɩwɩ ɩtrɛ́tɔ́. Labi ma mʋ́tɔ́ kugyíkʋtɔ.
Tɔɩ kpla ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔtɛtɩ́ ɩtrɛ́ wá ahá nsɩnɛ́ tse nyɔ pɛ́. Mʋ́ ɔma a, si mʋ asʋ́n.
Bɩ ánɩ́ ɔhá ámʋ odu nwuntɔ bʋ oklún. Oyin ánɩ́ lalahɛ mʋdɛbwɛ. Alahá mʋ ɩwɩ pɔ́n dodo.
Nenyá wá Artema ntɛ́ɛ Tihiko fʋ́ wá pɛ́, bɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ afʋbɔtʋ mɩ́ Nikopoli wúlutɔ, tsúfɛ́ nabwɛ́ agywɩɩn ánɩ́ nétsiá ɩnʋ atsalɩ bɩ́.
Bɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ afʋsi mbla osunápʋ́ Sena mʋa Apolo ɔkpa wankláán. Tɔtɔ ɩmáhián amʋ́ ɔkpatɔ.
Ha anɩ pɩ amʋ ɛ́ abʋbɩ alɩá bʋtɔbʋ́a aba agyʋ́má yɔ wankláán, mɛ́nɩ bɛ́talɩ́ kɩ ahá ánɩ́ bʋma tɔtɔsʋ. Fówun bʋmɔ́ɔbwɛ ahá ánɩ́ amʋ́ ɩwɩ mɔ́wa labi.
Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋbʋ mɩ́ wá nfɩ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛhá fʋ́ itsiá. Ahá ahógyipʋ amʋ́ʋ́ bʋtɔdwɛ́ anɩ ámʋ itsiá. Bulu ogyíi mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋalɛ.
